description:
Validate vault files against their schemas and report violations as <absolute path>:<line>: <message>.

Usage: lint [--schemas DIR] [--quiet] [PATHS ...]

Args:
  PATHS: zero or more files to validate. With none, the whole vault (ADULTING_HOME) is checked.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR   schemas directory (default: the schemas bundled with the package; leave unset)
  --quiet   no per-violation output; exit code only

Examples:
  []
  ["threads/Projects/SGB/hours.md"]
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Read-only.
  Reports files that are not valid UTF-8 as 'file is not valid UTF-8'. Other commands skip these files silently.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas loaded.
